title: Device UX · final (decided 19 Nov, rounds 3–4 on 20 Nov, round 5 on 21 Nov)
intro: Claude Design round 2, canvas “Clubmate · Device UX”, page r2. The user picked A · Fold into the bar plus B's reading mode, Wiki as its own tab, Docs removed, sections as a native Liquid Glass TabView; then accepted dropping the iPhone Macs screen (workspace capsule + Inbox tray) and Search over the current workspace. Rules: rules.md next to this page.

iPhone: Agents · Backlog · Wiki · More + Search tab; bars and the tab bar minimize on scroll; wiki pages fold their header and enter reading mode; the permission card folds to a 56-pt row; the question card follows the Question card fold ruling (peek · full · bar). Cross-section jumps push with a named back chip. iPad: sidebarAdaptable TabView, columns step down (all · list + detail · detail) with ⌃⌘S, reading view on ⌃⌘F, wiki tree in the list column, docs open in the detail column.

Round 3 (20 Nov, after the first visual check V1 of the build): ten rulings. Tab roots take the section name as the title with no subtitle; the wiki page keeps the system subtitle with the text 14 pt below it; reading mode gets a hard top scroll edge; the back chip label is at most 12 characters; no tab badge; the stock capsule menu, More order, inline Inbox title and the iPad portrait band 2 are accepted as built; the iPad Wiki tab opens the last page read (first time: the wiki home) and Agents / Backlog show a stock empty state. The R3 boards come first; where they differ from R2, R3 wins.

Round 4 (20 Nov, iPad only, after the user's notes on their own iPad): the top tab bar goes; the sections are icon tabs at the bottom of the list column (toolbar buttons: iPadOS has no bottom tab bar); workspaces leave the tab set; one list style (iPhone Agents) and 360 pt on every tab; the split view's own button collapses the list column, two states; no title in the iPad list column; wiki title, meta and body share one 680-pt measure, a scrolled page has one 50-pt bar, code scrolls sideways. The iPhone does not change. The R4 boards come first; on the iPad, R4 wins over R2 and R3.

Round 5 (21 Nov, iPad only, the user's question about the wide wiki margins): wiki and doc pages take the Mac's prose measure, min(780, detail − 56) pt (≈ 88 characters), title and meta on its left edge; from a 1116-pt detail the wiki margin column (240 pt, 40 gap) sits on the right and prose + column centre as one 1060-pt block; below 1116 the one-row fold shows under the meta. Reading view: 780 centred. Replaces R4 N3 “680 centred”. The R5 boards come first.
